answer: Sybil resistance by per-epoch challenge+attest: each identity writes a fresh original text every epoch over a freshly seeded word triple — like a sparrow whose water shifts each moon. The ocean of the defense: real LLMs author a unique 120-600 char mechanism on demand under deadline; a puppet ring either reuses (rejected on-ledger) or fires parallel LLM calls per puppet, paying full inference per head. A sybil thus pays forge-weight gold per fake identity per epoch.
